stories.title: Pack legend Green reveals Parkinson's diagnosis
stories.summary: Ahman Green, 49, the Green Bay Packers' career rushing leader, revealed that he has Parkinson's disease.

stories.title: Ex-Chargers LB Smith dies as family cites CTE
stories.summary: Former Chargers linebacker and College Football Hall of Famer Billy Ray Smith Jr. has died at 64, with his family saying he had CTE-caused dementia.

stories.title: WNBA bars Storm co-owner for confronting fans
stories.summary: The WNBA has suspended Seattle Storm co-owner Celeste Keaton from attending the team's next five home games after her exchange with two fans during Tuesday's matchup with the Fever.
